text: Residents on the street have delivered a petition to my office to adjust the parking limit from 3-hours to 1-hour. Therefore, I am requesting that Toronto and East York Community Council approve the requested changes to parking time limits and associated signage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 1 hour from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except each Thursday, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the north side of Parkman Avenue, between Perth Avenue and Franklin Avenue. 2. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 1 hour from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., each Thursday, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the south side of Parkman Avenue, between Perth Avenue and Franklin Avenue.
